evidence.actual: AADSTS50011: The redirect URI 'https://app.example.com/callback/' specified in the request does not match the redirect URIs configured for the application
evidence.note: Entra reports the redirect URI is not registered
Request has a trailing slash; the registered URI does not
Only the no-trailing-slash form is registered; no localhost or 127.0.0.1 entry is listed

output.fix: Make the redirect_uri the app sends match a registered URI exactly. The comparison is string-exact, so scheme, host, port, path and trailing slash all count. Either drop the trailing slash in the app's redirect_uri, or register the slash form as well. For local development, register each loopback origin you actually use, such as http://localhost:3000/callback and http://127.0.0.1:3000/callback, as separate entries. Don't use wildcards or loosen the matching. The same exact-match rule explains why localhost works and 127.0.0.1 doesn't: they are different hosts as far as the registration is concerned.

alternatives.why_not: The error text names a specific redirect URI mismatch (AADSTS50011), not a general client configuration problem.

questions: Which redirect URIs are registered for the dev environment? The expected config lists only the https://app.example.com one, so the localhost and 127.0.0.1 entries can't be confirmed.
